text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука has managed to leave
quite a
mark on the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We get together to watch the recording
of her
debut race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Now, what does Сайленс Судзука have in
store for
us today?"
text_block_list.name: Racing Commentator

text_block_list.text: Hehe, this really takes me back.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука has been head and
shoulders
above the rest since back
then.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In these past three years, her talent has
become
legendary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: We've gone through so much together.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hmm... I don't know...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I feel like I haven't changed much these
three
years.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I've seen her progress in each race with
my own
eyes. How can she think she
hasn't changed?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I've always loved running. It's almost the
only
thing I ever think of.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I've always been fixated on
getting into
the lead.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She has a point. While we've
encountered many
ups and downs, at
the end of the day, she's still
the same
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her desire to see the view from the front
of the
race remains. It's what motivates
her to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: But that's one of your strengths.

text_block_list.text: Yes, I think so too.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
So long as I continue to run my own way,
nothing
needs to change.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But I suppose I've grown in the
way I think
about things.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Her debut race, that she's only been

half-watching, has reached its end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We catch a glimpse of her in the footage
smiling
proudly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I was so happy that day.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And I can't wait to see how my running
evolves
from here on.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, this is really just the

beginning.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She says this all to herself, then turns to
look at
me once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I look forward to seeing what we
can do in
the future, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
